# Implementation Plan: Gate Anthropic/Claude transport behind an opt-in (default OFF)
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"codex-anthropic-models-opt-in-gate"} -->

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-09. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan D:/harness-efforts/codexu/.ralph/jobs/codex-anthropic-models-opt-in-gate/plan.md`.*

## Overview

The merged D-001 work (`codex-anthropic-models-support`, inner `40accc502` / wrapper
`98743a6c9`) makes Claude models available + routable **by default**: the live `/models`
filter admits chat-only Claude rows and `wire_route` routes them over
`api.githubcopilot.com/chat/completions`. The operator requires Anthropic/Claude support to
be **opt-in only, OFF by default** ("I don't want it enabled by default"). This plan gates the
entire D-001 behavior behind an explicit opt-in across **all four surfaces** — the `/models`
filter, the `WireApi::ChatCompletions` routing, the `/model` picker, and sub-agents (both v1
`multi_agent_v1.spawn_agent` and v2 `spawn_agent`, inherited and per-spawn override) — while
keeping GPT-5.x `/responses` **byte-unchanged in both gate states**. When OFF (default), codex
behavior is identical to pre-D-001: no Claude anywhere.

The chosen mechanism is an **environment variable** (`CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC`, default off)
read once per process via a fork-exclusive overlay helper (`OnceLock<bool>`), plus a launcher
config field (`enable_anthropic`) that sets it — mirroring the existing
`style_user_messages` -> `CODEX_TUI_USER_MESSAGE_STYLE` precedent. This satisfies the operator's
"a flag OR an env variable" with both an env var (ad-hoc) and a persistent config flag, while
adding **zero** `ConfigToml`/`FeatureSet` plumbing into the `model-provider` crate (which has no
config surface today) — the lowest-conflict, overlay-first option per `codex/CLAUDE.md` tenet 1.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
The D-001 transport spans four seams (all verified against source, see `research-brief.md`):
- **`/models` filter + wire-route tagging:** `model-provider/src/copilot_models_endpoint.rs`
  - `:53-62` `pub(crate) const CHAT_TRANSPORT_AVAILABLE: bool = true` — the existing
    "hidden-until-transport" guardrail const, now always true.
  - `:213-241` `is_chat_responses_picker_entry(entry)` -> `is_picker_entry_with_transport(entry, CHAT_TRANSPORT_AVAILABLE)`;
    admit = `has_responses || (chat_transport_available && has_chat)`. **The bool param is already
    the gate shape** — tests at `:361-420` already pass `false`/`true` directly.
  - `:245-259` `wire_route_for(entry)` tags a chat-only row `ModelWireRoute::ChatCompletions`.
  - `:261-347` `translate_entry` / `synthesize_from_capabilities` write `info.wire_route`.
- **Routing:** `core/src/chat_transport.rs:51-60` `effective_wire_api(route, provider_wire)` maps
  `ChatCompletions -> WireApi::ChatCompletions`; `core/src/client.rs:1585` calls it and the
  `:1627-1646` `WireApi::ChatCompletions =>` arm dispatches `stream_chat_completions(...)`.
- **`/model` picker:** `tui/src/chatwidget/model_popups.rs:20-30` reads
  `model_catalog.try_list_models()`; `tui/src/model_catalog.rs:5-16` holds `Vec<ModelPreset>`;
  `tui/src/app.rs:756,782` builds `ModelCatalog::new(bootstrap.available_models.clone())` from
  the models-manager catalog. The picker is populated from the same filtered catalog.
- **Sub-agents (v1 + v2 share one seam):** `core/src/tools/handlers/multi_agents_common.rs`
  - `:339-387` `apply_requested_spawn_agent_model_overrides` sources `available_models` from
    `session.services.models_manager.list_models(RefreshStrategy::Offline)` (`:351-355`).
  - `:445-463` `find_spawn_agent_model_name` REJECTS an unknown model:
    `"Unknown model `{requested_model}` for spawn_agent. Available models: {available}"`.
  - Call sites: `multi_agents/spawn.rs:98-111` (v1), `multi_agents_v2/spawn.rs:97-110` (v2).
  - Child inheritance: `build_agent_shared_config` sets `config.model = Some(turn.model_info.slug.clone())`.
- **Mechanism precedent:** launcher `codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot-launcher/src/config.rs`
  `SandboxConfig.style_user_messages`; `src/main.rs:111` `std::env::set_var("CODEX_TUI_USER_MESSAGE_STYLE", value)`;
  core reads it via `tui/src/style.rs:125-138` `user_message_styling_enabled()` cached in `OnceLock<bool>`.
- **Overlay home:** `codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/` (fork-exclusive, zero conflict surface) —
  `lib.rs` already exports the chat-transport helpers; the gate helper belongs here.

### Technical Constraints
- `model-provider` has **no** `Config`/`FeatureSet` surface (`CopilotModelsEndpoint::new(base_url, auth)`
  only); `core::client::stream` has only `model_info` + `provider_wire`. A Feature flag or
  ConfigToml field would require threading config through models-manager/provider/client — much
  larger upstream-canonical conflict surface. An env var read in an overlay helper reaches every
  seam with no plumbing.
- **Stale-cache bypass:** `OpenAiModelsManager` caches the fetched `/models` result at
  `~/.codex/models_cache.json` (5-min TTL). A cache written during an ON session can still hold
  `wire_route==ChatCompletions` Claude rows when re-read during an OFF session. Filtering the
  **live** fetch alone is therefore insufficient for "Claude not listed in `/model` when off" —
  a catalog/list-layer filter is required as a second defense, and the routing gate as the third.
- **In-process sub-agents** share the parent process env and the same `OnceLock` cache, so the
  gate value is identical parent<->child; no per-child divergence. A per-spawn explicit model
  override is the only bypass, and it routes through the (now-gated) `list_models`.
- Fork tenets (`codex/CLAUDE.md`): overlay-first; egress stays `api.githubcopilot.com` only; every
  upstream-canonical edit needs a `// SANDBOX PATCH:` marker + a patch-surface.md §14 invariant +
  §15 replant note. Rust conventions (`external/repos/codex-patched/AGENTS.md`): avoid mutating
  process env in tests (pass the resolved bool from above); use `/*param_name*/` comments on
  opaque literal bool args; `just fmt` after changes; `cargo check --workspace` is the local gate.

## Approach

### Architecture
A single source of truth — `anthropic_models_enabled()` in the overlay crate — resolves the gate
once per process (`OnceLock<bool>`, default false, accepts `on`/`1`/`true`). The launcher sets
`CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC` from its config field. **Three defense-in-depth gate points** consume the
resolved bool, each closing a distinct bypass:

| # | Gate point | File | Closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Live `/models` filter + `wire_route_for` | `copilot_models_endpoint.rs` | Claude admitted/tagged at fetch time |
| 2 | Cache-safe `GatedModelsManager` decorator | `copilot.rs::models_manager` (wraps BOTH manager branches) | Stale `models_cache.json` + config-supplied Claude rows in `/model` & spawn `available_models` |
| 3 | Routing `effective_wire_api` | `core/src/chat_transport.rs` (+ `client.rs` callsite) | Pinned/inherited/cached Claude model selected at request time |

Surfaces map to gates: (a) `/models` = gate 1+2; (b) routing = gate 3; (c) `/model` picker =
gate 1+2 (transitive via the catalog); (d) sub-agents = gate 2 (explicit override rejected by the
gated `list_models`) + gate 3 (inherited model fail-closed to `/responses`). All seam functions
take the resolved bool **as a parameter**; only the production wrappers call the helper, keeping
tests env-free.

### Implementation Strategy
Ordered so each story has a minimal, independently-testable diff:
1. **US-001** — overlay gate helper + launcher plumbing (foundation; everything depends on it).
2. **US-002** — gate the live `/models` filter + `wire_route_for` (surface a; part of b).
3. **US-003** — cache-safe `GatedModelsManager` decorator wrapping the `SharedModelsManager`
   returned by `copilot.rs::models_manager` (stale-cache + config-catalog defense for surfaces a/c/d).
4. **US-004** — gate `effective_wire_api` routing (surface b; pinned/inherited/cached defense).
5. **US-005** — sub-agent acceptance tests, v1 + v2, explicit-override + inherited, both states (surface d).
6. **US-006** — `/model` picker acceptance test both states + GPT `/responses`-unchanged proof (surfaces c + GPT invariant).
7. **US-007** — patch-surface.md invariants (modify 34/35, add new) + §15 replant + doc-drift fix.

## Scope
### In Scope
- The env-var + launcher-config gate mechanism and the 3 defense-in-depth gate points.
- Gating all 4 surfaces (filter, routing, `/model` picker, sub-agents v1+v2) in both states.
- Tests for both gate states on all 4 surfaces + a GPT `/responses`-unchanged test.
- patch-surface.md invariant + replant updates; the doc-drift fix the research found.
### Out of Scope
- **No version bump and no release cut** (the release is the separate dependent task
  `codex-cut-release-with-anthropic-transport`).
- No change to the chat-completions transport behavior itself (D-001 internals) when ON — only
  gating whether it is reachable.
- No new runtime toggle (gate is read once per process; changing it requires a relaunch, matching
  the `style_user_messages` precedent).
- No upstream PR; this stays a fork SANDBOX PATCH.
- No `~/.codex/config.toml` ConfigToml field (rejected — see Open Questions / mechanism rationale).

## Risk Areas
- **Stale `models_cache.json` (HIGH):** the live filter alone leaves a window where a cache from a
  prior ON session shows Claude in `/model`. Mitigated by gate 2 (catalog/list filter) — must be
  proven with a cached-`ChatCompletions`-row test in both states.
- **Config-pinned / inherited Claude model (MEDIUM):** a user `model = "claude-..."` in
  `~/.codex/config.toml`, or a child inheriting it, bypasses the catalog filter. Mitigated by gate
  3 (`effective_wire_api` fail-closes to `/responses`). Must be proven with a routing test for a
  `ChatCompletions` hint with gate off.
- **GPT `/responses` regression (MEDIUM):** the gate must NOT touch GPT rows. GPT rows carry
  `/responses` (admitted regardless), `wire_route=ProviderDefault`, and route to `Responses` in
  both states. Add an explicit cross-state GPT test.
- **Cache-safe filter placement (resolved → MEDIUM):** the `GatedModelsManager` decorator MUST wrap
  the `SharedModelsManager` returned by `copilot.rs::models_manager()` in BOTH branches (the
  `OpenAiModelsManager` path AND the `StaticModelsManager`/`config_model_catalog` path), and MUST
  filter EVERY read method that exposes remote models (`list_models`, `try_list_models`,
  `raw_model_catalog`, `get_remote_models`, `try_get_remote_models`) — the TUI picker uses
  `try_list_models`, not `list_models`. Filtering only `CopilotModelsEndpoint::list_models` (the
  live fetch) or only `list_models` leaves cached/offline reads and the picker path unfiltered.
  Keep the decorator in the overlay/`model-provider` layer so upstream `models-manager` stays
  untouched (no SANDBOX PATCH there). See F-001.
- **Test env-mutation (LOW):** per AGENTS.md, tests must pass the resolved bool, not mutate
  `CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC`. The existing `is_picker_entry_with_transport(entry, bool)` shape is the
  template; the gate helper exposes an env-free inner fn for its own unit test.
- **Argument-comment lint (LOW):** new bool params at literal callsites need `/*anthropic_enabled*/`
  comments; consider a 2-variant enum if the bool proliferates (implementer's call — prefer the
  existing bool+comment convention for minimal churn).

## Acceptance Criteria
1. With **no** opt-in set (default): `/models` excludes chat-only Claude rows; the live filter and
   `wire_route_for` produce the pre-D-001 result (verified by extended `chat_transport_tests`).
2. With the opt-in set: chat-only Claude rows are admitted and tagged `wire_route=ChatCompletions`
   (existing D-001 behavior preserved).
3. Routing: with gate off, `effective_wire_api(ChatCompletions, Responses) == Responses` (a stale
   `ChatCompletions` hint NEVER reaches the chat transport); with gate on, it returns
   `ChatCompletions`. GPT (`ProviderDefault`) returns `Responses` in both states.
4. Cache-safe: a `models_cache.json` `ModelInfo` (and a `config_model_catalog`-supplied entry) with
   `wire_route==ChatCompletions` is excluded from the `GatedModelsManager` read methods
   (`list_models`, `try_list_models`, `raw_model_catalog`, `get_remote_models`,
   `try_get_remote_models`) when off, included when on (new colocated decorator tests).
5. `/model` picker: when off, no Claude rows are listed/selectable; when on, Claude rows appear
   (explicit TUI test in both states; the picker reads `try_list_models`, which the decorator gates).
6. Sub-agents (v1 AND v2): when off, a spawn_agent child requesting a Claude model via the explicit
   `model` param is rejected ("Unknown model ... for spawn_agent") because the gated
   `list_models`/`available_models` excludes it; a child inheriting a pinned Claude `config.model`
   resolves through `effective_wire_api(ModelWireRoute::ChatCompletions, Responses, /*off*/) ==
   Responses` and issues NO `/chat/completions` request (the `stream` dispatch never enters the
   chat arm); when on, children may use Claude. Tests for both v1 and v2, both override + inherited.
7. GPT-5.x `/responses` path is unchanged across both gate states, verified by concrete assertions
   (not a literal whole-path byte invariant): a GPT row is admitted by the filter identically in
   both states, carries `wire_route==ProviderDefault`, and
   `effective_wire_api(ProviderDefault, Responses, /*on|off*/) == Responses` in both states; where
   an existing request-construction test exists, the serialized outbound `/responses` request body
   for a GPT turn is identical across gate states (the gate code path is never entered for GPT rows).
8. `cargo check --workspace` (from `external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs`) passes; `just fmt`
   clean; `just fix -p <crate>` clean and `just test -p <crate>` passes for each touched crate
   (`codex-model-provider`, `codex-core`, `codex-tui`, `codex-copilot`, `codex-copilot-launcher`).
   Per `external/repos/codex-patched/AGENTS.md`, do NOT run `cargo test` directly — use `just test`.
9. Launcher precedence: an explicit `enable_anthropic = true|false` in `~/.codex-copilot/config.toml`
   sets `CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC=on|off`; when the field is UNSET the launcher does NOT write the env
   var, leaving any caller-provided `CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC` intact (tested both ways).
10. patch-surface.md §14 invariants 34 + 35 updated to reflect the gate; a new invariant added for
    "Anthropic transport opt-in default-off across all four surfaces; GPT `/responses` unchanged";
    §15 replant note added; the drifted routing-test path corrected.
11. No new network egress host/path (still `api.githubcopilot.com` only) — `scripts/audit_network_calls.sh`
    and `scripts/audit_invariants.sh` clean.

## Suggested Decomposition

This is a single-crate-cluster codex-submodule change with a strict dependency chain (every story
needs the US-001 helper; US-002/003 share `copilot_models_endpoint.rs`/`copilot.rs`; the test and
doc stories depend on the production gates). It is **best run serially as one impl member** —
parallelism offers no benefit and the shared files would conflict.

### Cluster: anthropic-opt-in-gate
- Stories: US-001, US-002, US-003, US-004, US-005, US-006, US-007
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=`model-provider/src/copilot_models_endpoint.rs`,
  `model-provider/src/copilot.rs`, `core/src/chat_transport.rs`, `core/src/client.rs`,
  `codex-rs-overlay/codex-copilot/src/lib.rs`, multiple shared test files,
  `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md`; exclusive=none meaningful; risk=high (single coherent
  change to interlocking seams).
- `execution_mode` rationale: All stories mutate the same small set of interlocking files in a
  strict dependency order; splitting across parallel members would produce conflicting edits to
  `copilot_models_endpoint.rs`, `chat_transport.rs`, and `patch-surface.md`. Run serially.

## Open Questions
- **Mechanism final form:** plan locks **env var `CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC` (default off) + launcher
  config field `enable_anthropic`**. Feature flag and `~/.codex/config.toml` field were considered
  and rejected (no model-provider config surface; larger conflict surface; schema regen). Confirm
  the env-var NAME with the operator if a different idiom is preferred (`CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC` vs
  `CODEX_COPILOT_ANTHROPIC` vs `CODEX_ENABLE_CLAUDE`). [INFERRED default: `CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC`.]
- **Cache-safe filter seam (US-003) — RESOLVED:** a fork-local `GatedModelsManager` decorator
  wraps the `SharedModelsManager` in BOTH branches of `copilot.rs::models_manager()` and filters
  all remote-model read methods when off; upstream `models-manager` is left untouched. (Was an open
  question; pinned by Phase-4 review F-001.)
- **Accepted env values:** `on`/`1`/`true`/`yes` (case-insensitive) = enabled; everything else
  (incl. unset) = disabled. [INFERRED — mirror `style.rs` parsing; confirm in review.]
- **Whether US-005/US-006 need any production code** beyond US-002/003/004: expected to be
  test-only, but if the inherited-Claude fail-closed path surfaces a gap (e.g., a child error
  message), a small production fix may move into US-004/US-005.
